name: geely-ethiopia
description: Geely Ethiopia - two independent codebases: web/ (public site, port 3002) and admin/ (panel + Prisma/DB, port 3001). See web/package.json and admin/package.json for scripts.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix web --omit=dev --audit-level=critical && npm audit --prefix admin --omit=dev --audit-level=critical
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
